title: Same-day buy 50 / sell 80: 50 matched as intraday (speculative, s.43(5)), remaining 30 sold FIFO from an older delivery lot
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.43(5): a transaction in shares settled otherwise than by actual delivery is speculative; s.28 / Explanation 2 - speculative business income, not capital gains
Data-model rule (brief): the same-day matched quantity of one holding is intraday; only the excess goes through FIFO capital gains
Income-tax Act 1961 s.2(42A) first proviso; s.112A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: 12.5 % above Rs 1,25,000 for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024
derivation: 2025-06-10: buy 50 @ 600.00 and sell 80 @ 610.00, same holding, same day -> matched quantity min(50, 80) = 50 is intraday.

Intraday row: 50 units, cost 50 x 600 = 30,000.00, proceeds 50 x 610 = 30,500.00 (speculative profit 500 is business income, outside capital gains). gain is reported null because it is not a capital gain; tax_cost omitted (not applicable); term intraday, rate null.
Unmatched sale quantity 80 - 50 = 30 goes FIFO to the 2024-01-10 lot: cost 30 x 500 = 15,000.00, proceeds 30 x 610 = 18,300.00, gain 3,300.00.
FY 2025-26 (fy 2026): LTCG 3,300 <= 1,25,000 -> exemption_used 3,300.00, tax 0.00, cess 0.00, total 0.00; intraday_count 1.
Row order within the same sale date: intraday row first, then FIFO row (ordering convention only).
Open lot: 100 - 30 = 70 @ 500.00 acquired 2024-01-10; the same-day buy lot is fully consumed by the intraday match.
